tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Valentine's Day gift inspiration. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, defaultDomain, catalogCount, tagConfigured, and marketplaces[] (domain, label, tagConfigured). Use this first to discover supported Amazon storefronts. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Same data as get_health.marketplaces. Pick the user's store and pass marketplace on search/catalog/resolve: amazon.com (US) or amazon.se (Sweden, default).

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for Valentine's / romantic gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise romantic-filtered search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. Prefer buyUrl / trackingTag in results. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated Valentine gift starters. On amazon.se and amazon.com items include /dp/ASIN buy links (separate curated catalogs per store); on other marketplaces catalogMode is search-ideas. tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or romantic search). Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers or amazon.se for Sweden (fallback: country, then Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se). tools.description: Create a Valentine's gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. tools.description: One call: create a curated Valentine's Day (Alla hjärtans dag) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a Valentine wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. Use recipientName, occasion, cat

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Prefer buyUrl in responses. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
